olivia: Heads-up: quick RFC follow-up — proposal to ship a 'slim image + content-index' pattern for air-gapped on-prem upgrades. TL;DR: smaller seed image + pointer index to deltas, operator applies only required blobs.

sanjay: Sounds promising. Main risk is operator mental model + rollback complexity. How do we ensure atomicity if apply fails mid-stream?

olivia: Right. Thinking of two-phase activation: fetch blobs to staging, verify signatures, then switch activation marker. Operator-visible states: downloading -> verified -> staged -> activated. We can expose a simple `activation_id` for rollbacks.

maya: How do we handle GC and disk pressure? Some nodes have tiny disks.

olivia: Good call. We plan per-component retention policy: keep last N activations + optional streamed blobs eviction. Also allow operator flag `keep-seeds=false`.

tom: If we use content-index pointers, need stable addressing — content-addressed by sha256 and length. Eg:
```
{ "path": "models/ggml-v1", "sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...", "size": 123456789 }
```

sanjay: Validation: signer chain + timestamped manifest. If manifest claims incompatible variant (quantized vs fp16) we should auto-fallback to compatible variant or fail? I'd vote fail + human review.

olivia: Auto-fallback is useful for hosted but for Private we should be strict. Make it configurable via `strict_manifest_mode`.

maya: Ops UX: operator needs a single `apply` CLI that shows progress and safe-checks. Example:
```
redwoodctl onprem apply --manifest /tmp/manifest.json --staging /var/lib/redwood/staging
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout started for tenant-demo in lab region :rocket:

tom: One more: delta compression. For large model shards we should support chunked resumes and range checksums so partial retries don't retransfer whole shard.

olivia: Agreed. Also propose 'compact index' for constrained devices — index contains only required shard ranges for a pinned activation.

sanjay: Can we summarize action items?

olivia: Sure — 1) Draft two-phase activation operator state machine, 2) Spec manifest schema with `strict_manifest_mode`, 3) Add chunked resume support + range checksums, 4) CLI UX mockups. I'll open an RFC PR with these sections.

maya: I'll prototype the staging GC flags and disk-pressure metrics.

tom: I'll write the chunked-range proto. ping me on the PR.

olivia: Thanks all. Filing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/XXXX will link shortly :thumbsup:
